title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
content: A bill to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has cleared committee and is eligible for a House vote, but it faces a tight deadline.

title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk
content: The government opposed the measures citing existing EU data-sharing rules and non-legal tender status, leaving the 2027 budget open.

title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
content: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
content: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
content: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

title: 1Password hacker stole customer names and emails, but vaults safe
content: The password manager, which is used by millions of people to store their login credentials, said customer vaults were unaffected by the breach.

title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions
content: US Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen, among others, have taken aim at two recent SEC efforts to ease regulatory requirements for the crypto industry.

title: AI labs likely sitting on cryptography ‘bombshells,’ computer scientist says
content: AI is driving a massive wave of mathematical breakthroughs which could have implications for cryptography.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Switzerland clears 57 jurisdictions for crypto tax data sharing
content: The move paves the way for Switzerland to exchange crypto tax data with foreign authorities starting in 2028 as part of a global effort to combat tax evasion.

title: China's Google Just Released Its Fast New AI Model for Free
content: Baidu has released the weights of its new high-speed reasoning model, giving developers a commercially usable alternative to proprietary AI services from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic

title: What Happened to Alice Huang, the Woman at the Center of Nvidia’s Scandal?
content: U.S. intelligence found no evidence that Beijing directed Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia’s CEO, but the former Megaspeed executive still faces entry bans and scrutiny of business ties.

title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
content: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.

title: Another Bitcoin Mining Firm Flags 'Hashrate Hijacking' Attacks That Reroute Rewards
content: Braiins says an attacker exploited the unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, striking over 1,000 sites in a single second.

title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
content: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.

title: Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor
content: Bitcoin Magazine Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor Rep. Nick Begich's bill to write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law, with a 20-year ban on selling its bitcoin, is now eligible for a House floor vote. This post Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028
content: Bitcoin Magazine Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028 Switzerland approved 57 partner jurisdictions, including all EU states and the UK, for automatic crypto tax data exchanges under the OECD's CARF from 2028. This post Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
